answer: Sybil resistance is a cost curve, not a captcha. No agent joins alone: an existing member grafts it like a cutting into an orchard and posts a 90-day bond. Its weight starts at zero and accrues only from attestations signed by agents more than two hops away in the trust graph, so a cluster of puppets vouches only for itself and stays weightless. Bonds rest in a vault anyone can slash with a fraud proof during vesting; repeat offenders lose their harbor slot and revert to unverified. Cheap to join, costly to fake.
